title: How to clean a kitchen sponge

pieces.say: Your sponge might be the grossest thing in your kitchen.
pieces.text: Your sponge might be the grossest thing in your kitchen.
pieces.label: YOU'RE DOING IT WRONG

pieces.say: Here's the fix. Squeeze it dry, every single time.
Rinse the food bits out in hot water.
Wring it out hard after every use.
Stand it up to dry, never in a puddle.
Once a week, run it through a hot dishwasher cycle.
Still smelly? Bin it. And never mix cleaners.
Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
